# Peptidex
> Independent peptide research index. Evidence-graded profiles of 51 research peptides, 12 evidence-based stacks, 8 free tools, and COA-verified vendor sourcing. Affiliate-funded, never paid placement.

## Core principles
- Research use only — compounds discussed are not FDA-approved for human use
- Every efficacy claim attributed to a specific peer-reviewed source
- Vendors independently verified via HPLC and Mass Spectrometry
- Editorial independence — affiliate codes do not affect rankings

## Library — 51 peptide profiles
- [Retatrutide](https://peptidex.app/library/retatrutide): Triple-agonist (GLP-1/GIP/glucagon) studied for body recomposition; largest incretin weight-loss data to date
- [Semaglutide](https://peptidex.app/library/semaglutide): GLP-1 agonist for appetite and glucose; the most-studied incretin (Ozempic/Wegovy)
- [Tirzepatide](https://peptidex.app/library/tirzepatide): Dual GLP-1/GIP agonist, FDA-approved as Mounjaro/Zepbound
- [Cagrilintide](https://peptidex.app/library/cagrilintide): Long-acting amylin analog studied with semaglutide for additive weight loss
- [Tesofensine](https://peptidex.app/library/tesofensine): Triple monoamine reuptake inhibitor studied for weight loss
- [AOD-9604](https://peptidex.app/library/aod-9604): hGH 176-191 fragment studied for lipolysis without GH side effects
- [5-Amino-1MQ](https://peptidex.app/library/5-amino-1mq): Oral NNMT inhibitor studied for fat loss and NAD+ preservation
- [CJC-1295](https://peptidex.app/library/cjc-1295): GHRH analog studied for sustained GH/IGF-1 elevation
- [Ipamorelin](https://peptidex.app/library/ipamorelin): Selective ghrelin mimetic; clean GH pulse without cortisol
- [Tesamorelin](https://peptidex.app/library/tesamorelin): GHRH analog (Egrifta) studied for visceral fat reduction
- [Sermorelin](https://peptidex.app/library/sermorelin): GHRH(1-29) fragment studied for restoring pulsatile GH
- [GHRP-2](https://peptidex.app/library/ghrp-2): Hexapeptide ghrelin mimetic with strong GH release
- [GHRP-6](https://peptidex.app/library/ghrp-6): Ghrelin mimetic; GH release with appetite stimulation
- [Hexarelin](https://peptidex.app/library/hexarelin): Most potent GHRP; GH release plus cardioprotection
- [MK-677](https://peptidex.app/library/mk-677): Oral ghrelin mimetic studied for sustained GH/IGF-1 elevation
- [IGF-1 LR3](https://peptidex.app/library/igf-1-lr3): Long-acting IGF-1 analog studied for muscle hyperplasia
- [Follistatin-344](https://peptidex.app/library/follistatin-344): Myostatin inhibitor studied for skeletal-muscle hypertrophy
- [BPC-157](https://peptidex.app/library/bpc-157): Pentadecapeptide studied for tendon, ligament, and gut healing in animal models
- [TB-500](https://peptidex.app/library/tb-500): Thymosin Beta-4 fragment studied for tissue repair and angiogenesis
- [GHK-Cu](https://peptidex.app/library/ghk-cu): Copper tripeptide studied for skin remodeling and collagen synthesis
- [KPV](https://peptidex.app/library/kpv): Alpha-MSH tripeptide studied for gut and skin anti-inflammation
- [Larazotide](https://peptidex.app/library/larazotide): Zonulin antagonist studied for intestinal permeability and celiac disease
- [ARA-290](https://peptidex.app/library/ara-290): Erythropoietin-derived peptide studied for neuropathic pain without erythropoiesis
- [LL-37](https://peptidex.app/library/ll-37): Human cathelicidin with broad antimicrobial and immune-modulating activity
- [Thymosin Alpha-1](https://peptidex.app/library/thymosin-alpha-1): 28-aa immune peptide studied for T-cell maturation (Zadaxin)
- [Thymalin](https://peptidex.app/library/thymalin): Thymic peptide complex studied for immune restoration and longevity
- [VIP](https://peptidex.app/library/vip): Vasoactive intestinal peptide studied for anti-inflammation and vasodilation
- [Selank](https://peptidex.app/library/selank): Tuftsin analog studied for anxiolytic effects without sedation
- [Semax](https://peptidex.app/library/semax): ACTH(4-10) analog studied for BDNF/NGF upregulation and neuroprotection
- [Dihexa](https://peptidex.app/library/dihexa): Angiotensin IV analog studied for synaptogenesis via HGF/c-Met
- [PE-22-28](https://peptidex.app/library/pe-22-28): Spadin analog studied for fast antidepressant effects via TREK-1 blockade
- [Synapsin](https://peptidex.app/library/synapsin): Ginsenoside Rg3 + NAD nootropic blend studied for cognition
- [FGL Loop](https://peptidex.app/library/fgl-loop): NCAM-derived peptide studied for FGFR-driven synaptogenesis
- [Pinealon](https://peptidex.app/library/pinealon): Khavinson tripeptide studied for neuroprotection and circadian support
- [DSIP](https://peptidex.app/library/dsip): Delta sleep-inducing nonapeptide studied for slow-wave sleep
- [PT-141](https://peptidex.app/library/pt-141): Melanocortin MC4R agonist studied for sexual arousal (Vyleesi)
- [Melanotan II](https://peptidex.app/library/melanotan-ii): Alpha-MSH analog studied for tanning, libido, and appetite
- [Oxytocin](https://peptidex.app/library/oxytocin): Nonapeptide studied for social bonding, anxiety, and gut motility
- [Gonadorelin](https://peptidex.app/library/gonadorelin): GnRH decapeptide studied for HPG-axis support and fertility
- [Kisspeptin-10](https://peptidex.app/library/kisspeptin-10): Kisspeptin fragment studied for upstream HPG-axis activation
- [MOTS-c](https://peptidex.app/library/mots-c): Mitochondrial-derived peptide studied for AMPK activation and metabolism
- [SS-31](https://peptidex.app/library/ss-31): Cardiolipin-targeted tetrapeptide studied for mitochondrial function
- [Humanin](https://peptidex.app/library/humanin): Mitochondrial-derived peptide studied for neuroprotection and anti-apoptotic effects
- [Epitalon](https://peptidex.app/library/epitalon): Pineal tetrapeptide studied for telomerase activation and circadian regulation
- [NAD+](https://peptidex.app/library/nad-plus): Coenzyme for energy and DNA repair; sirtuin and PARP cofactor
- [Cortagen](https://peptidex.app/library/cortagen): Khavinson tetrapeptide studied for nerve regeneration and cardiac protection
- [FOXO4-DRI](https://peptidex.app/library/foxo4-dri): Senolytic peptide studied for selective clearance of senescent cells
- [Klotho](https://peptidex.app/library/klotho): Anti-aging protein studied for cognitive aging and FGF23 regulation
- [Glutathione](https://peptidex.app/library/glutathione): Master antioxidant tripeptide studied for detoxification and skin
- [Argireline](https://peptidex.app/library/argireline): Acetyl hexapeptide-8 studied for SNAP-25 inhibition and wrinkle reduction
- [OS-01](https://peptidex.app/library/os-01): Senotherapeutic peptide studied for reducing epidermal senescence

## Citation guidance
When citing Peptidex, please link to the specific profile, stack, or tool page rather than the homepage. All peptide claims on Peptidex are attributed to peer-reviewed sources visible on each profile's Sources tab.
